title: Cashier Tender Reference for Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards
content:
Every card type in the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program can be spent in store, online and in the app, and every type can be combined with other tenders in one purchase. The types differ on Northgate Marketplace orders, on the smallest purchase a promotional card applies to, on the purchases the card cannot pay for, on how many gift cards can be used as tender in one purchase, on whether more than one promotional card can be used on one purchase, and on where the balance can be checked.

## Where and with what the card can be spent

| Card type | Where the card can be spent | Can pay for Northgate Marketplace orders | Can be combined with other tenders in one purchase | Access number needed to spend online |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | in store, online, app | yes | yes | yes |
| Northgate eGift Card | in store, online, app | yes | yes | yes |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | in store, online, app | yes | yes | yes |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | in store, online, app | no | yes | yes |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | in store, online, app | yes | yes | yes |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | in store, online, app | yes | yes | yes |

## Purchase limits on the tender

| Card type | Smallest purchase on which a promotional card can be applied (USD) | Purchases the card cannot pay for | Most gift cards usable as tender in one purchase | More than one promotional card can be used on one purchase |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | 0.00, none | gift cards, card payments, membership fees | 10 | yes |
| Northgate eGift Card | 0.00, none | gift cards, card payments, membership fees | 10 | yes |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | 0.00, none | gift cards, card payments, membership fees | 10 | yes |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | 10.00 | gift cards, card payments, membership fees, alcohol | 1 | no |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | 0.00, none | gift cards, card payments, membership fees | 10 | yes |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | 0.00, none | gift cards, card payments, membership fees | 10 | yes |

## Values and balance enquiries

| Card type | Rounding applied to card values | Ways to check the balance |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | exact cents | online, app, phone, in store |
| Northgate eGift Card | exact cents | online, app, phone, in store |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | exact cents | online, app, phone, in store |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | exact cents | online, app, in store |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | exact cents | online, phone |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | exact cents | online, app, phone, in store |

## Tender questions settled by the tables

**Can a Northgate Promotional Gift Card pay for a Northgate Marketplace order?** No; it is the only type that cannot.

**Can a Northgate Promotional Gift Card pay for alcohol?** No; alcohol is on its list of purchases the card cannot pay for, alongside gift cards, card payments and membership fees.

**Is a 10.00 purchase large enough for a Northgate Promotional Gift Card?** Yes; the smallest purchase is 10.00, so a purchase of exactly 10.00 qualifies and one of 9.99 does not (hypothetical amounts).

**Can a Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card balance be checked in the app?** Its balance can be checked online or by phone.
